text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway,
Haru Urara came walking toward me, looking unwell...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
My head is pounding...
Just like when you eat way too much ice cream—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hawa!! Not again...!!
BAM BAM BAAAM!

"And so, Haru Urara was troubled
by a headache..."
